_about: SQL Drills' layer on top of the Waffles tokens (waffles/). Fonts replace Waffles' font (never copied). themes.light / themes.dark map the roles pages use to colours; a value naming a Waffles colour ("navy", "grey100", "blueText") is taken from waffles/color, a hex value is ours. textVariants.dark gives every colour family a text colour that reads on the dark surfaces (Waffles only defines them for light, and four of its light ones are darkened slightly to pass on grey). tools/contrast-audit.mjs checks every text role against every surface in both themes.

font.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

fontWeight._note: Waffles' bold is 800; IBM Plex is loaded up to 700.

light._note: Waffles text colours darkened by the least amount that reaches 4.5:1 on the grey surfaces (Waffles made them for white). Families not listed keep the Waffles value.
